lessons.title: Recording an Expense

steps.title: Create an expense
steps.instruction: Click Expense from the + New menu.

feedback.incorrect: Click Expense in the Vendors column.

steps.title: Choose the payee
steps.instruction: Select Office Supply Co as the payee.

feedback.incorrect: Choose Office Supply Co from the Payee dropdown.

steps.title: Choose a category
steps.instruction: Set the category to Office expenses.

feedback.incorrect: Choose Office expenses as the category.

steps.title: Save the expense
steps.instruction: Click Save to record the expense.

feedback.incorrect: Click Save at the bottom of the form.

quiz.question: Why is the expense category important?
options: It controls how the expense appears on reports
quiz.correctAnswer: It controls how the expense appears on reports
quiz.explanation: Categories map expenses to accounts that appear on financial reports.

lessons.completionMessage: You recorded and categorized a business expense.

lessons.title: Uploading a Receipt

steps.title: Confirm vendor
steps.instruction: Select City Utilities as the vendor detected from the receipt.

feedback.incorrect: Choose City Utilities from the vendor field.

steps.title: Add the receipt
steps.instruction: Click Add to attach the receipt to the books.

feedback.incorrect: Click Add after confirming the vendor.

quiz.question: What does attaching a receipt help preserve?
quiz.explanation: Receipts provide support for recorded expenses and can help during reviews.

lessons.completionMessage: You uploaded and attached a receipt for an expense.

lessons.title: Categorizing Expenses

steps.title: Open a bank line
steps.instruction: Click the Office Supply Co bank transaction.

feedback.incorrect: Click the Office Supply Co row.

steps.title: Assign category
steps.instruction: Choose Office expenses as the transaction category.

feedback.incorrect: Select Office expenses from the category menu.

steps.title: Add the transaction
steps.instruction: Click Add to post the reviewed transaction.

feedback.incorrect: Click Add on the transaction detail.

quiz.question: What does Add do in the bank feed review workflow?
options: Posts the reviewed bank line to the books
quiz.correctAnswer: Posts the reviewed bank line to the books
quiz.explanation: Adding a bank feed item records it using the selected category and details.

lessons.completionMessage: You reviewed, categorized, and added a bank-feed expense.

lessons.title: Bill Payment

steps.title: Create a bill
steps.instruction: Click Create bill for Metro Rentals.

feedback.incorrect: Click Create bill on the vendor card.

steps.title: Set due date
steps.instruction: Choose the due date field and set the bill to due this month.

feedback.incorrect: Click the due date field on the bill.

quiz.question: What is the difference between a bill and an expense in QuickBooks?
options: A bill records an amount to pay later
A bill is only for customers
A bill is a payroll tax form
A bill cannot have a vendor
quiz.correctAnswer: A bill records an amount to pay later
quiz.explanation: Bills track payables until you pay the vendor.

lessons.completionMessage: You created and scheduled a vendor bill payment.
